title: Galactic Dynamics
description: Map how fast the Galaxy's hydrogen turns at each distance from its centre and the stars alone cannot hold it together: something unseen outweighs them several times over. Unlocks the long galactic survey.

puzzle.goal: A cloud of gas circles the centre of a galaxy at radius r, held by the gravity of the mass M inside its orbit. Write the speed v it must have to stay on a circle.
puzzle.name: Circular orbital speed
puzzle.ask: Find v in km/s for the Sun's orbit: M = @{M} kg within r = @{r} m, G = 6.674e-11.
puzzle.method: Gravity supplies exactly the centripetal force: G M m / r² = m v² / r.
